note: This place is hosts a popular weekly Sunday Market
priceRange: No entrance fee. Minimum spend for daybeds starts from Rp 700.000++ and premium beachfront seating from Rp 2.400.000++.
description: is an eco-friendly beach club in Canggu, Bali, known for its rustic design using reclaimed wood from over 500 fishing boats. It features a tropical ambiance with pools, beach access, and is situated on Echo Beach, offering stunning sunset views. The venue serves global cuisine with a focus on sustainably sourced seafood, cocktails, and coffee, and also hosts a popular weekly Sunday Market.
